rows.label: Flat LUK
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 LUK = 1 Attack, 1 DEX = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: LUK %
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 LUK = 1 Attack, 1 DEX = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: DEX
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 LUK = 1 Attack, 1 DEX = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: CRIT_RATE %
rows.semantics: Book of Ancient (if equipped): Crit Damage follows the crit-rate change

rows.label: ATTACK_SPEED % (diminishing returns, factor 150)
rows.semantics: Athena's Gloves (if equipped): Max Damage follows; Bottle of Emotion (if equipped): Final Damage follows

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 2nd Job
rows.semantics: adds Agile Claws' (Attack Speed), Physical Training's (Basic Attack Damage), Claw Mastery's (Min Damage) and Critical Throw's (Crit Rate, Crit Damage) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 3rd Job
rows.semantics: adds Enveloping Darkness' (Boss Damage) and Expert Throwing Star Handling's (Attack%) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 4th Job
rows.semantics: adds Claw Expert's (Skill Damage), Dark Harmony's and Shadow Shifter's (Final Damage) level deltas; Night Lord's Mark feeds Assassin's Mark's Final Damage

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — All Skills
rows.semantics: adds every passive's level delta (Agile Claws, Physical Training, Claw Mastery, Critical Throw, Enveloping Darkness, Expert Throwing Star Handling, Claw Expert, Dark Harmony, Shadow Shifter)
